model.name: HiT-B/16 D27 (minit2i-b16-hit-d27)
model.layout: 27 blocks as 3/3/15/3/3; two grouping stages over image patches and valid caption tokens
model.source: Frozen inference source in the checkpoint export (source/minit2i-b16-hit-d27)

runtimeNote: The trained run used the Blackwell FlashAttention-4 profile on B300 GPUs. This export uses the native PyTorch attention path on an H100 slice, with the same FP32 GPU tree backend.
scope: Teacher-noised real images with their captions. These are not generated samples.

method.image: RGB uint8 to float32 NCHW: pixel / 127.5 - 1
method.input: real * t + noise * (1 - t); t = 1 is the clean image; the model receives t as its time token
method.display: (input + 1) * 127.5; clip to [0, 255]; round to uint8 RGB
method.inputHash: SHA-256 of the float32 NCHW C-order bytes before display clipping
method.forward: One batch for each image: all input times, the same caption and noise, need_budget=False
method.hardGroups: Level 1: stage-1 group of each original position. Level 2: stage-2 group of that stage-1 group.
method.pooling: P1 = A1 / column mass. Level 1 uses A1 and P1. Level 2 uses A1 @ A2 and P1 @ P2.
method.tokenToImage: For the hard group of the token: the pooling column over the 1,024 image patches.
method.patchToCaption: Row of A @ P.T for the image patch, restricted to the caption tokens.
method.notAttention: These are routing weights. They are not attention maps, attribution, or object masks.
method.encoding: Each .bin file holds little-endian float32 values for both levels: token groups x 1024, then 1024 x tokens.
